summary: Central Elections Committee chair Justice Noam Sohlberg rejected a petition seeking to prohibit free distribution of Ben-Gvir/Otzma Yehudit's illustrated children's book 'The Minister Who Didn't Stop' on election-propaganda grounds.
notes: Freshness pass preserves the exculpatory procedural outcome: the petition was rejected after responses were received. No adverse election-law finding arose from this matter, so no canonical accountability event is created. This does not prejudge separate election-law disputes involving Ben-Gvir videos or state resources.
